text_block_list.text: —Even during grueling training, Hishi Akebono is always smiling.

I want to do everything I possibly can for her.
One holiday, as I spent hours in trial and error
while sacrificing sleep—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hello!
Even though it's your day off, I knew you'd be here~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "It's snack time☆ Let's take a break~!"
choice_data_list: No, there's still something left to do...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Right this way for a party of one~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's dangerous, so stay still~!
And off we go☆"

Suddenly getting scooped up by Hishi Akebono,
I was carried over to—
choice_data_list: Why are you at the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I asked nicely, and they let me
borrow the kitchen for a little bit~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A few of them are already done!
I'll bring them right over~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for waiting☆
First up is donuts with ice cream~!

Placed on the desk was a cute half-chocolate-covered doughnut
and some beautiful emerald-colored ice cream.
However, what caught my attention even more was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's super nice.
I'm so glad they made it just like I asked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, eat your ice cream before it melts.
There's plenty more coming up next~!

Sweet after sweet was brought out from the kitchen.
Just as that gentle sweetness permeated my body
and I started feeling full, I suddenly noticed something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you noticed!? Ehehe, that's right~
Everything I just pulled out
is part of this racing outfit~!

"Donuts, ice cream, strawberry cake—
Indeed, they are all incorporated into her racing outfit's design."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Umm... Trainer, were the donuts and cakes buono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's great!
After all, buono makes everyone happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Filled with contentment and feeling so happy... a smile just comes naturally."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So before and after the race,
I hope seeing this racing outfit will make everyone feel a little bit like that too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And then, if you could smile genuinely from the bottom of your heart just like you are now, Trainer, I'd be so super happy!
...Now that you mention it, with how busy things have been lately, I might have been wearing a rather grim expression.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome!
There's still more cookie dough left, so I'll go bake another batch☆
choice_data_list: The cookies on your shoes and back, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Corr~ect!
I'm gonna make all kinds of other shapes too, though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I wonder what kind of shape
you'd like, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me!
I'll deliver plenty of buono
to make everyone smile lots and lots☆

The warm, gently sweet cookies
seemed to embody
Hishi Akebono's wish itself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't worry about it!
You're tired, Trainer, so take it easy today—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Together with... Bono...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yeah, you're right!
Trainer and I have to be together, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's make lots of it, Trainer!
Lots of buono! Lots of smiles! ☆

The cookies we made together were a mix of shapes
and flavors, turning out to be fun and
absolutely buono!
